<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="SymB7"><title>SymB7</title>
<style>

:root{--bg:#0f1419;--card:#1a222b;--ln:#2c3844;--tx:#e8edf2;--mu:#93a1af;--ac:#3fa34d}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:15px/1.4 -apple-system,system-ui,sans-serif}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:#26323e;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px}button.p{background:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac);color:#fff}
#splash{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0a0d10;z-index:50;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;transition:opacity .6s}
#sl{font:800 44px system-ui;letter-spacing:6px;color:#fff;margin-top:env(safe-area-inset-top)}#sc{color:#9fb0c0;font-size:14px;min-height:20px;text-align:center}
#sw{position:relative;width:min(96%,640px)}#sw img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:8px}
.sd{position:absolute;top:25.1%;width:1.7%;min-width:7px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#1c2a1c}#s9{left:24.6%}#s10{left:26.5%;background:#3a1010}
.sd.fl{animation:sf .5s steps(1) infinite}.sd.on{background:#2eea4a;box-shadow:0 0 8px 3px #2eea4a}@keyframes sf{0%{background:#ff2b2b;box-shadow:0 0 8px 3px #f22}50%{background:#3a1010;box-shadow:none}}
#cv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}.fade{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#app{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);padding-bottom:calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
header{padding:10px 14px;font-weight:800;font-size:19px}header small{color:var(--mu);font-weight:400;font-size:12px;margin-left:6px}
section{display:none;padding:0 12px 16px}section.on{display:block}
nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;background:#0b0f13;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom);z-index:5}
nav button{flex:1;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;font-size:11px;padding:8px 2px;color:var(--mu)}nav button.on{color:var(--ac)}nav b{display:block;font-size:19px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:12px;padding:11px;margin:10px 0}.card h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:15px}.mu{color:var(--mu);font-size:13px}
#bd{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:manipulation}#bd img{width:100%;display:block}#ar{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.lcd{position:absolute;left:40.2%;top:46.4%;width:27.4%;height:10.6%;background:#b9d15c;color:#10200a;border:2px solid #1b1f12;font:700 min(2.25vw,14px)/1.3 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;padding:0 1%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;border-radius:2px;}.lcd div{white-space:pre;height:1.3em;overflow:hidden}
.k{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;padding:0;position:absolute;width:7%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2px solid #3fa34d00}.k:active{background:#3fa34d66;border-color:#3fa34d}
.led{position:absolute;width:.9%;min-width:5px;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:transparent;border:0;padding:0}.led::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-10px}.row .led::after{display:none}.row .led{--off:#333}
.row .led{position:static;display:inline-block;width:14px;min-width:14px;height:14px;vertical-align:middle;transform:none;margin-right:6px;background:#333;border-color:#666}
.led.on.g{background:#2eea4a;box-shadow:0 0 3px #2eea4a}.led.on.y{background:#ffd21f;box-shadow:0 0 3px #ffd21f}.led.on.r{background:#f33;box-shadow:0 0 3px #f33}.led.on.b{background:#2d8cff;box-shadow:0 0 5px 1px #2d8cff}
.led.fl.g{animation:f 1s steps(1) infinite}.led.fl.y{animation:f 1s steps(1) infinite}.led.fl.r{animation:f 1s steps(1) infinite;--c:#f33}.led.fl.b{animation:f 1s steps(1) infinite;--c:#2d8cff}.led.fast{background:#2eea4a66;animation:f .1s steps(1) infinite}.led.irr{animation:i 1.7s steps(1) infinite}
.led.fl{--c:#2eea4a}.led.fl.y{--c:#ffd21f}
@keyframes f{0%{background:var(--c,#2eea4a);box-shadow:0 0 3px var(--c,#2eea4a)}50%{background:var(--off,transparent);box-shadow:none}}@keyframes i{0%,30%,62%{background:#2eea4a;box-shadow:0 0 3px #2eea4a}12%,45%,80%{background:var(--off,transparent);box-shadow:none}}
.pb{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid #777;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.pop{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#fff;color:#000;border-radius:50%;font:700 9px system-ui;width:5%;aspect-ratio:1;display:none}
#coach{font-size:14px}#coach .st{padding:8px;border-radius:8px;background:#0e2540;border:1px solid #2d8cff;margin-top:6px}
.step{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);opacity:.5}.step.done{opacity:.9}.step.cur{opacity:1}.step i{font-style:normal;min-width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#26323e;text-align:center;font-size:12px;line-height:22px}.step.done i{background:var(--ac)}.step.cur i{background:#2d8cff}
.bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:8px 0}
details{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:12px;margin:8px 0;padding:9px 11px}summary{font-weight:700}details p,details li{font-size:14px}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:12.5px}td,th{border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:4px;vertical-align:top;text-align:left}
.tree div{padding:3px 0;font-size:14px}.tree .m{font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;color:var(--ac)}.tree a{color:#7ab8ff}
#ph{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000b;z-index:20;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center}#ph.on{display:flex}
#pf{background:#fff;color:#111;width:min(100%,400px);height:min(100%,780px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#pf .top{background:#eee;padding:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 12px 8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}#pf .top button{background:none;border:0;color:#2a7;padding:0}
#pb{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:10px;font-size:14px}#pb button{background:#eef1f3;border-color:#d5dbe0;color:#111}#pb button.p{background:#4cae3c;color:#fff}
#pt{display:flex;border-top:1px solid #ddd}#pt button{flex:1;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#fff;color:#888;font-size:11px;padding:7px 0}#pt button.on{color:#4cae3c}
.li{padding:11px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}.li small{display:block;color:#4a9a3c}.g2{color:#4a9a3c}.sev{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px;margin:6px 0}
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#0007;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;z-index:3}.modal>div{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;width:100%}
#s-learn .lks{margin-top:8px}.lk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:13px}.lk span{flex:1}.chip{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#7ab8ff;background:#13273b;border:1px solid #2d5a88;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.chip.pdf{color:#9fb0c0;background:#1a222b;border-color:var(--ln)}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:80px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#000d;color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:20px;z-index:60;display:none;font-size:13px;max-width:90%}

.scr{display:none}.scr.on{display:block}.wrap{padding:0 12px 16px}
#app{padding-bottom:calc(66px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
nav{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}nav button{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:64px}
#top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--bg);z-index:4;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln)}#top b{font-size:17px}#top .mu{flex:1;text-align:right;font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sb{width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--tx);background:#0b0f13;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin:8px 0}
.tcard{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin:10px 0;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--card);border-left:6px solid var(--c,#3fa34d)}.tcard b{font-size:18px}.tcard span{display:block;color:var(--mu);font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.big{width:100%;padding:12px;margin:8px 0;font-weight:700}
.res{background:#0e1620;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:10px;margin:4px 0}.res div{padding:9px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:14px}.res small{color:var(--mu)}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:6px;padding:1px 6px;margin-right:4px;background:#26323e;color:#cfd8e0}.tag.wo{background:#7a2630;color:#fff}.tag.cf{background:#5a4a14}.tag.sp{background:#1d4a2a}.tag.tr{background:#3a2a66}
.sub{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:8px 0;overflow-x:auto}.sub button{flex:0 0 auto}.sub button.on{background:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac)}
.dz{border:2px dashed #3f5366;border-radius:14px;padding:22px 10px;text-align:center;background:#0e1620}.dz.over{border-color:var(--ac);background:#10261a}
.fld{display:block;margin:8px 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--mu)}.fld input,.fld select{display:block;width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--tx);background:#0b0f13;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:8px;padding:9px;margin-top:3px}
.pr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:14px}.pr .nm{flex:1}.pr .v{font-weight:700;color:#7ab8ff;text-align:right}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:5px}.chips button{font-size:11px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px}.chips button.on{background:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac)}
.hint{font-size:13px;color:#b8c7d6;background:#102030;border:1px solid #28425c;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin:8px 0}
.flip{animation:fl2 .35s ease-out}@keyframes fl2{0%{transform:rotateX(90deg);opacity:.2}100%{transform:none;opacity:1}}
#mod{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000c;z-index:90;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px}#mod.on{display:flex}#mod>div{background:#1a222b;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;width:100%;max-width:420px}
.lk a.chip{margin-left:4px}
.sw{display:inline-block;width:46px;height:26px;border-radius:13px;background:#3a4550;position:relative;vertical-align:middle}.sw::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:.15s}.sw.on{background:#d33}.sw.on::after{left:23px}

<div id="splash"><div id="sl">BEFORE</div><div id="sc">LED 10 flashing red = alarm</div><div id="sw"><img id="sp-img" alt="Symbio 700 board"><i id="s9" class="sd"></i><i id="s10" class="sd fl"></i></div><canvas id="cv"></canvas></div>
<div id="app">
<div id="home" class="scr on"><header>SymB7<small>Symbio™ 700 trainer</small></header><div class="wrap">
 <div class="hint"><b>How it works:</b> 1) Pick your controller type. 2) Type in model, serial and firmware. 3) Upload a trend .CSV and tap <b>Simulate trends</b>. 4) Watch the board, LEDs, menus and app react. 5) Tap <b>Learn</b> any time.</div>
 <input id="gs" class="sb" placeholder="🔎 Search all types and files…"><div id="gres"></div>
 <div id="cards"></div>
 <button class="big p" onclick="openWork('general','files')">📁 Repository – all files &amp; links</button>
</div></div>
<div id="work" class="scr">
 <div id="top"><button onclick="goHome()">‹ Types</button><b id="tn"></b><span id="tu" class="mu"></span></div>
 <div class="wrap"><input id="ws" class="sb" placeholder="🔎 Search this type…"><div id="wres"></div>
 <section id="s-board"><div class="hint">Real board photo. Tap the keypad icons (or the backup buttons below) and watch the LCD. Long text flips through like a Rolodex.</div>
  <div id="bd"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Symbio 700 board"><div class="lcd"><div id="l1"></div><div id="l2"></div></div><svg id="ar"></svg></div>
  <div class="card" id="sel" style="display:none"></div><div class="card" id="coach"></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Keypad buttons</h3><div class="mu">Backup buttons – same as the icons on the board.</div><div id="pad" style="margin-top:8px"></div><div class="mu" style="text-align:center;margin-top:6px">Home · Bluetooth · ▲ ▼ ◄ ► · ✔ Enter · ↺ Cancel</div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>LED locator</h3><div class="mu">Tap an LED to point a red arrow at it on the board and read its function. Positions are approximate.</div><div id="blist"></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Lesson: Connect via Bluetooth (pp. 6–9)</h3><div id="steps"></div><div class="bar"><button onclick="rst()">↺ Reset lesson</button></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Fault lab (p. 9 troubleshooting)</h3><div class="bar"><button onclick="flt('range')">Walk out of range</button><button onclick="flt('other')">2nd user connects</button><button onclick="boot()">Cycle controller power</button></div><div class="mu">Watch the blue LED and the status line above.</div></div></section>
 <section id="s-led"><div class="card"><h3>Unit Controller LEDs</h3><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="width:100%;border-radius:8px" alt="LED legend"><div class="bar"><button id="b-eth" onclick="tg('eth')">Ethernet cable: off</button><button id="b-al" onclick="tgAlarm()">Active alarm: off</button><button id="b-vfd" onclick="tg('vfd')">VFD / SZVAV: off</button></div><div class="mu">Relay LEDs also react to Service Test Mode and to simulated trend values (fan, compressors, heat, defrost, reheat).</div></div><div class="card" id="llist"></div></section>
 <section id="s-menu"></section>
 <section id="s-data"></section>
 <section id="s-learn"></section>
 <section id="s-quiz"></section>
 <section id="s-files"></section>
 </div>
 <nav id="nav"></nav>
</div></div>
<div id="ph"><div id="pf"><div class="top"><span>Symbio Service &amp; Installation</span><button onclick="$('#ph').classList.remove('on')">Close ✕</button></div><div id="pb"></div><div id="pt"></div></div></div><div id="mod"></div><div id="toast"></div>

function cfgFields(t){const T=TY[t];return[['sys','System type',T.sys],['fan','Supply fan',T.fan],['heat','Heating',T.heat],['econ','Economizer / outdoor air',['None','0–50% motorized damper','0–100% economizer'].concat(T.traq?['0–100% economizer w/ TRAQ']:[])],['comps','Compressors',T.comps.map(String)]].concat(T.dehum?[['dehum','Dehumidification',['None','Dew point','Relative humidity']]]:[]).concat(T.vs?[['vscomp','Variable speed compressor',['No','Yes']]]:[]).concat([['leak','Refrigerant leak detection',['Not installed','Installed']]])}
function cfg(t){const c=CFs[t]||(CFs[t]={});cfgFields(t).forEach(f=>{if(!f[2].includes(c[f[0]]))c[f[0]]=f[2][0]});return c}
function tags(t){const c=cfg(t),s=new Set();if(c.econ!='None')s.add('econ');if(/TRAQ/.test(c.econ))s.add('traq');if(c.heat=='Heat pump')s.add('hp');if(c.heat=='Gas')s.add('gas');if(c.heat=='Electric')s.add('elec');if(c.heat!='Cooling only')s.add('heat');if(c.fan=='Variable speed')s.add('vsfan');if(c.fan!='Single speed')s.add('msfan');if(+c.comps>=2)s.add('comp2');if(+c.comps>=3)s.add('comp34');if(c.dehum&&c.dehum!='None')s.add('dehum');if(c.leak=='Installed')s.add('leak');if(c.vscomp=='Yes')s.add('vscomp');if(c.sys=='VVZT')s.add('vvzt');return s}

function svcVar(t){const v=GD[t].svc;if(t!='odyssey')return v[0];const c=cfg(t),i=({'Single speed':0,'Multi-speed':1,'Variable speed':2})[c.fan]*2+(c.heat=='Heat pump'?1:0);return v[i]||v[0]}
function tests(t){const tg=tags(t);return svcVar(t).steps.map(s=>s.n).filter(n=>!/^Inactive$/i.test(n)).filter(n=>!(/^(Heat|Aux|Emergency)/i.test(n)&&!tg.has('heat'))&&!(/Reheat/i.test(n)&&!tg.has('dehum'))&&!(/Defrost/i.test(n)&&!tg.has('hp'))&&!(/Econ/i.test(n)&&!tg.has('econ')))}
function testRow(t,n){const v=svcVar(t),s=v.steps.find(x=>x.n==n);return s?{cols:v.cols,vals:s.v,pg:v.pg,title:v.t}:null}
function testLeds(n){if(!n||!W)return[];const L=new Set();if(/Defrost/i.test(n)){L.add(19);L.add(5)}const r=testRow(W,n);if(!r)return[...L];let comp=0;r.cols.forEach((c,i)=>{const v=String(r.vals[i]||''),num=parseFloat(v);if(/fan/i.test(c)&&!/speed|relief|condenser/i.test(c)&&/^on/i.test(v))L.add(21);if(/supply fan speed/i.test(c)&&(num>=100||/^max/i.test(v)))L.add(22);if(/compres/i.test(c)&&!/vfd/i.test(c)&&num>0)comp=Math.max(comp,num);if(/aux|heat stage/i.test(c)&&num>0)L.add(22);if(/reheat/i.test(c)&&(/^(on|open)/i.test(v)||num>0))L.add(20)});if(comp>=1){L.add(5);L.add(1)}if(comp>=2){L.add(15);L.add(2)}if(comp>=3){L.add(17);L.add(4)}if(/^Heat/i.test(n))L.add(22);return[...L]}
function diagInfo(t){return GD[t].diag.map((d,i)=>({...d,i}))}
function diagList(t){const tg=tags(t);return diagInfo(t).filter(d=>!(/Refrigerant/i.test(d.n)&&!tg.has('leak'))&&!(/VFD/i.test(d.n)&&!tg.has('vsfan'))&&!(/Reheat|Dehumid/i.test(d.n)&&!tg.has('dehum'))).map(d=>d.n)}

function alarms(){if(!W||W=='general')return[];const a=diagList(W).filter(n=>(DGON[W]||{})[n]);allPts(W).forEach(p=>{if((p.k=='T'||/alarm status|diagnostic|fault|trip|failure/i.test(p.n))&&/alarm|diagnostic|fault|trip|failure/i.test(p.n)&&on(val(W,p.n))&&!/^(none|normal)$/i.test(String(val(W,p.n))))a.push(p.n)});return[...new Set(a)]}
function litLeds(){const L=new Set(testLeds(S.test));if(!W||W=='general')return[...L];const n=re=>pts(W).some(p=>re.test(p.n)&&on(val(W,p.n)));if(n(/supply fan (status|speed)/i))L.add(21);if(n(/compressor 1|cooling stage request|cooling capacity status/i)){L.add(5);L.add(1)}if(n(/compressor 2/i)){L.add(15);L.add(2)}if(n(/compressor 3/i)){L.add(17);L.add(4)}if(n(/heat stage|heating capacity|gas heat|electric heat/i))L.add(22);if(n(/defrost status|reversing valve/i))L.add(19);if(n(/reheat status|hot gas reheat/i))L.add(20);return[...L]}

function chunks(s){s=String(s);if(s.length<=16)return[s];const out=[];let cur='';for(let w of s.split(/\s+/)){while(w.length>16){if(cur){out.push(cur);cur=''}out.push(w.slice(0,16));w=w.slice(16)}if(!cur)cur=w;else if((cur+' '+w).length<=16)cur+=' '+w;else{out.push(cur);cur=w}}if(cur)out.push(cur);return out}

const wr=(i,n,d)=>(i+d+n)%n,pStep=p=>p.st||(p.u=='°F'?.5:p.u=='%'?5:p.u=='inWC'?.1:1);
function cycle(opts,cur,d){const i=opts.indexOf(String(cur));return opts[wr(i<0?0:i,opts.length,d)]}
function key(k){if(S.boot||!W)return;if(k=='bt')return btn();
 const m=MENU(),MN=Object.keys(m),mn=MN[M.mi],sub=Object.keys(m[mn]);
 if(k=='home'){M={mode:'nav',lvl:0,mi:0,si:0,pi:0,ed:0,ev:null}}
 else if(M.mode=='bt'){if(k=='ok'&&S.code){S.bt=2;S.code=null;S.other=0;toast('Pairing complete')}else if(k=='cancel'||k=='ok'&&!S.code)M.mode='nav'}
 else{const items=M.lvl==2?m[mn][sub[M.si]]():[],it=items.length?items[M.pi%items.length]:null;
  if(M.ed){const p=it.p;if(k=='up'||k=='down'){const d=k=='up'?1:-1;if(p.o)M.ev=cycle(p.o,M.ev,d);else{let v=(+M.ev||0)+d*pStep(p);if(p.min!=null)v=Math.max(p.min,v);M.ev=+v.toFixed(2)}}else if(k=='ok'){setVal(W,p.n,M.ev);M.ed=0;toast('Value written: '+p.n+' = '+M.ev)}else if(k=='cancel')M.ed=0}
  else if(k=='up'||k=='down'){const d=k=='up'?-1:1;if(M.lvl==0)M.mi=wr(M.mi,MN.length,d);else if(M.lvl==1)M.si=wr(M.si,sub.length,d);else M.pi=wr(M.pi%items.length,items.length,d)}
  else if(k=='ok'){if(M.lvl==0){if(mn=='Bluetooth')M.mode='bt';else{M.lvl=1;M.si=0}}else if(M.lvl==1){M.lvl=2;M.pi=0}else if(it){
     if(it.test){S.test=S.test==it.test?null:it.test}
     else if(it.act=='restart')boot();else if(it.act=='btoff'){S.bt=0;S.other=0;S.code=null;toast('Bluetooth radio disabled')}else if(it.act=='diagreset'){DGON[W]={};toast('Diagnostics reset')}
     else if(it.cfgKey){const c=cfg(W);c[it.cfgKey]=cycle(it.opts,c[it.cfgKey],1);cfgChanged()}
     else if(it.p&&it.w){M.ed=1;M.ev=val(W,it.p.n)}
     else toast('Read-only on the controller. Use Data ▸ Points to override it in the simulator.')}}
  else if(k=='cancel'&&M.lvl>0)M.lvl--}
 draw()}

 else{const mn=MN[Math.min(M.mi,MN.length-1)];if(M.lvl==0){a=mn;b=M.mi==0?'Enter View Data':'Enter  >';path=mn}else{const sub=Object.keys(m[mn]);if(M.lvl==1){a=mn;b=sub[M.si];path=mn+' › '+b}else{const items=m[mn][sub[M.si]](),it=items[M.pi%items.length];a=it.l;b=M.ed?'*'+M.ev:(it.v?it.v():it.vs);path=mn+' › '+sub[M.si]+' › '+it.l+'  ('+(M.pi%items.length+1)+' of '+items.length+')'}}}

 if(alarms().length)h+=`<div class="st" style="background:#2a1012;border-color:#d33"><b>${alarms().length} active alarm${alarms().length>1?'s':''}</b> · alarm output relay <b>${alarmRelay()?'ON':'OFF'}</b></div>`;

const LN=[['Introduction (p.5)','<p>Factory-installed digital control and protection for light commercial packaged equipment: one Symbio 700 main controller plus up to four option modules (may or may not be present).</p><b>Features</b><ul><li>Open &amp; flexible: configuration/troubleshooting software, field-upgradable, works with mobile service tech so customers choose their servicer, full BAS communication suite, optional TGP2 and XM support (Tracer TU required).</li><li>Remote connectivity: remote access/monitoring for troubleshooting without a site visit via Trane Connect.</li></ul>'],

let qi=0,qs=0;function quiz(){if(qi>=Q.length){$('#s-quiz').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><h3>Score ${qs}/${Q.length}</h3><button class="p" onclick="qi=qs=0;quiz()">Retry</button></div>`;return}const q=Q[qi];$('#s-quiz').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="mu">Question ${qi+1}/${Q.length}</div><h3>${q[0]}</h3>${q[1].map((o,i)=>`<p><button style="width:100%;text-align:left" onclick="ans(${i},this)">${o}</button></p>`).join('')}</div>`}
function ans(i,b){const q=Q[qi];if(b.parentNode.parentNode.dataset.d)return;b.parentNode.parentNode.dataset.d=1;if(i==q[2]){qs++;b.className='p'}else{b.style.background='#7a2630'}toast(i==q[2]?'Correct':'Answer: '+q[1][q[2]]);setTimeout(()=>{qi++;quiz()},1300)}

let _db=null;const idb=()=>new Promise((res,rej)=>{if(_db)return res(_db);try{const r=indexedDB.open('symb7',1);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{r.result.createObjectStore('files',{keyPath:'id'});r.result.createObjectStore('trend',{keyPath:'type'})};r.onsuccess=()=>{_db=r.result;res(_db)};r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error)}catch(e){rej(e)}});
const dbAll=async st=>{try{const d=await idb();return await new Promise(r=>{const q=d.transaction(st).objectStore(st).getAll();q.onsuccess=()=>r(q.result);q.onerror=()=>r([])})}catch(e){return[]}};
const dbPut=async(st,o)=>{try{const d=await idb();return await new Promise(r=>{const q=d.transaction(st,'readwrite').objectStore(st).put(o);q.onsuccess=()=>r(1);q.onerror=()=>r(0)})}catch(e){toast('Storage is blocked in this browser mode');return 0}};
const dbDel=async(st,k)=>{try{const d=await idb();return await new Promise(r=>{const q=d.transaction(st,'readwrite').objectStore(st).delete(k);q.onsuccess=()=>r(1);q.onerror=()=>r(0)})}catch(e){return 0}};
/* ===== repository ===== */
let RP=[];
async function repoInit(){RP=await dbAll('files');if(!LSg('sb7_seed',0)){LSs('sb7_seed',1);for(const [n,u] of [['Trane website','https://www.trane.com'],['Trane Technologies','https://www.tranetechnologies.com']]){const o={id:'s'+n,name:n,kind:'link',url:u,cats:['general'],added:Date.now()};RP.push(o);await dbPut('files',o)}}}
const uid=()=>Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
const fsz=n=>n>1e6?(n/1e6).toFixed(1)+' MB':n>1e3?Math.round(n/1e3)+' KB':n+' B';
const ico=o=>o.kind=='link'?'🔗':o.kind=='note'?'📝':/^image/.test(o.mime||'')?'🖼️':/pdf/.test(o.mime||'')?'📕':/csv|excel|sheet/.test((o.mime||'')+o.name)?'📊':'📄';
async function addFiles(fl,cat){for(const f of fl){const o={id:uid(),name:f.name,kind:'file',mime:f.type,size:f.size,blob:f,cats:cat=='general'?['general']:[cat],added:Date.now()};if(await dbPut('files',o))RP.push(o)}toast(fl.length+' file(s) added');renderFiles()}
async function addLink(cat){const u=prompt('Paste the link (https://…)');if(!u)return;const n=prompt('Name for this link',u)||u;const o={id:uid(),name:n,kind:'link',url:/^https?:/.test(u)?u:'https://'+u,cats:[cat],added:Date.now()};await dbPut('files',o);RP.push(o);renderFiles()}
async function addNote(cat){const n=prompt('Note title');if(!n)return;const t=prompt('Note text')||'';const o={id:uid(),name:n,kind:'note',text:t,cats:[cat],added:Date.now()};await dbPut('files',o);RP.push(o);renderFiles()}
async function toggleCat(id,c){const o=RP.find(x=>x.id==id);if(!o)return;o.cats=o.cats.includes(c)?o.cats.filter(x=>x!=c):[...o.cats,c];await dbPut('files',o);renderFiles()}
async function delItem(id){if(!confirm('Delete this item from the whole repository?'))return;RP=RP.filter(x=>x.id!=id);await dbDel('files',id);renderFiles()}
function openItem(id){const o=RP.find(x=>x.id==id);if(!o)return;if(o.kind=='link')window.open(o.url,'_blank');else if(o.kind=='note')alert(o.name+'\n\n'+o.text);else{const u=URL.createObjectURL(o.blob);window.open(u,'_blank')}}
let FALL=0;
function renderFiles(){const cat=W,q=($('#fq')||{}).value||'';const showAll=cat=='general'||FALL;let L=RP.filter(o=>showAll||o.cats.includes(cat));if(q)L=L.filter(o=>(o.name+' '+(o.text||'')+' '+(o.url||'')).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
 $('#s-files').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Your repository: add any file type, links to Trane websites, pictures or notes. Tap the section chips on an item to add it to or remove it from a category.</div>
 <div class="card"><h3>📁 Repository${cat=='general'?' (all files)':' – '+TY[cat].n}</h3><div class="bar"><label><button class="p" onclick="this.nextElementSibling.click()">＋ Add files</button><input type="file" multiple hidden onchange="addFiles(this.files,'${cat}')"></label><button onclick="addLink('${cat}')">＋ Link</button><button onclick="addNote('${cat}')">＋ Note</button></div>
 <input id="fq" class="sb" placeholder="🔎 Search files in the repository…" value="${esc(q)}" oninput="renderFiles();const e=$('#fq');e.focus();e.setSelectionRange(e.value.length,e.value.length)">
 ${cat!='general'?`<label class="mu"><input type="checkbox" ${FALL?'checked':''} onchange="FALL=this.checked;renderFiles()"> Show every file, not just this section</label>`:''}</div>
 ${L.length?L.sort((a,b)=>b.added-a.added).map(o=>`<div class="card"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><span style="font-size:24px">${ico(o)}</span><div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><b style="word-break:break-word">${esc(o.name)}</b><div class="mu">${o.kind=='file'?fsz(o.size)+' · '+esc(o.mime||'file'):o.kind=='link'?esc(o.url):esc((o.text||'').slice(0,80))}</div></div></div>
 <div class="chips">${ORDER.map(c=>`<button class="${o.cats.includes(c)?'on':''}" onclick="toggleCat('${o.id}','${c}')">${TY[c].n}</button>`).join('')}</div>
 <div class="bar"><button class="p" onclick="openItem('${o.id}')">Open ↗</button><button onclick="delItem('${o.id}')">🗑 Delete</button></div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="card mu">Nothing here yet. Tap “＋ Add files”, “＋ Link” or “＋ Note”.</div>'}`}
/* ===== trend CSV ===== */
function parseCSV(txt){txt=txt.replace(/^\uFEFF/,'');const f=txt.split(/\r?\n/).slice(0,12).join('\n'),cnt=c=>f.split(c).length-1,d=[',',';','\t'].sort((a,b)=>cnt(b)-cnt(a))[0],rows=[];let r=[],c='',q=0;for(let i=0;i<txt.length;i++){const ch=txt[i];if(q){if(ch=='"'){if(txt[i+1]=='"'){c+='"';i++}else q=0}else c+=ch}else if(ch=='"')q=1;else if(ch==d){r.push(c);c=''}else if(ch=='\n'||ch=='\r'){if(ch=='\r'&&txt[i+1]=='\n')i++;r.push(c);c='';if(r.some(x=>x.trim()!==''))rows.push(r);r=[]}else c+=ch}r.push(c);if(r.some(x=>x.trim()!==''))rows.push(r);return rows}
const pnum=s=>{const m=/^\s*(-?\d[\d,]*\.?\d*(?:e[-+]?\d+)?|-?\.\d+)\s*[%°A-Za-z\/"]*\s*$/i.exec(String(s));return m?parseFloat(m[1].replace(/,/g,'')):NaN};
const nz=s=>String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,' ').trim();
const STOP=new Set(['unit','symbio','point','value','present','pv','status','active']);
function score(a,b){const x=nz(a),y=nz(b);if(x==y)return 1;if(x.length>5&&y.length>5&&(x.includes(y)||y.includes(x)))return .8;const A=new Set(x.split(' ').filter(w=>!STOP.has(w))),B=new Set(y.split(' ').filter(w=>!STOP.has(w)));if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;let i=0;A.forEach(w=>B.has(w)&&i++);return i/(A.size+B.size-i)}
function bestPoint(t,name){let b=null,s=0;allPts(t).filter(p=>p.k!='T').forEach(p=>{const v=score(name,p.n);if(v>s){s=v;b=p}});return s>=.6?b.n:''}
function buildTrend(t,rows,fname){let h=rows.findIndex((r,i)=>r.length>=2&&rows[i+1]&&r.filter(x=>x.trim()&&isNaN(pnum(x))).length>=Math.max(2,r.length*.5)&&rows[i+1].filter(x=>!isNaN(pnum(x))).length>=1);if(h<0)h=0;const hd=rows[h].map(x=>x.trim()),data=rows.slice(h+1);let tc=hd.findIndex(x=>/time|date|stamp/i.test(x));if(tc<0)tc=hd.findIndex((x,i)=>data[0]&&data[0][i]&&isNaN(pnum(data[0][i]))&&!isNaN(Date.parse(data[0][i])));
 const times=data.map((r,i)=>tc>=0?(r[tc]||'').trim():'Row '+(i+1));const cols=[];hd.forEach((x,i)=>{if(i==tc||!x)return;const v=data.map(r=>{const s=(r[i]||'').trim(),n=pnum(s);return s===''?null:isNaN(n)?s:n});if(v.every(y=>y===null))return;cols.push({h:x,v,map:bestPoint(t,x)})});return{type:t,name:fname,times,cols}}
function linkTrend(t){CP[t]=[];const T=TRD[t];if(!T)return;T.cols.forEach(c=>{if(c.map===''||c.map==null||!allPts(t).some(p=>p.n==c.map)){const first=c.v.find(x=>x!==null);if(!CP[t].some(p=>p.n==c.h))CP[t].push(mk([c.h,'Trend','T',typeof first=='number'?'':'',typeof first=='number'?first:(first||'')]));c.map=c.h}})}
async function loadTrendFile(f){if(!f)return;const t=W;try{const rows=parseCSV(await f.text());if(rows.length<2){toast('That file has no data rows');return}TRD[t]=buildTrend(t,rows,f.name);linkTrend(t);await dbPut('trend',TRD[t]);TS.idx=0;stopSim();applyRow();toast(TRD[t].cols.length+' columns × '+TRD[t].times.length+' rows loaded');draw();renderData()}catch(e){toast('Could not read that file')}}
const TS={play:0,idx:0,spd:1,timer:null};
function applyRow(){const T=TRD[W];if(!T)return;const i=Math.min(TS.idx,T.times.length-1);VT[W]=VT[W]||{};T.cols.forEach(c=>{if(c.map&&c.v[i]!==null&&c.v[i]!==undefined)VT[W][c.map]=c.v[i]});draw()}
function startSim(){const T=TRD[W];if(!T){toast('Upload a trend file first');return}stopSim();TS.play=1;TS.timer=setInterval(()=>{TS.idx++;if(TS.idx>=T.times.length)TS.idx=0;applyRow();simUI()},1000/TS.spd);simUI()}
function stopSim(){TS.play=0;clearInterval(TS.timer);simUI()}
function simUI(){const T=TRD[W],e=$('#simbar');if(!e||!T)return;e.querySelector('#simt').textContent=(T.times[TS.idx]||'')+'  ·  row '+(TS.idx+1)+' of '+T.times.length;e.querySelector('input[type=range]').value=TS.idx;const b=e.querySelector('#simgo');b.textContent=TS.play?'⏸ Stop simulating':'▶ Simulate trends';b.className=TS.play?'':'p'}
function clearTrendVals(){VT[W]={};draw();renderData()}
async function dropTrend(){if(!confirm('Remove the uploaded trend for this type?'))return;stopSim();delete TRD[W];CP[W]=[];VT[W]={};await dbDel('trend',W);draw();renderData()}
/* ===== Data tab (Unit · Trends · Points · Alarms) ===== */
function renderData(sub){const el=$('#s-data');if(sub)el.dataset.sub=sub;sub=el.dataset.sub||'unit';const tabs=[['unit','🛠 Unit'],['trend','📈 Trend data'],['points','🎚 Points'],['diag','🚨 Alarm library'],['tests','▶ Service tests'],['wire','🔌 Wiring'],['sens','🌡 Sensor check']];
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="sub">${tabs.map(t=>`<button class="${t[0]==sub?'on':''}" onclick="renderData('${t[0]}')">${t[1]}</button>`).join('')}</div><div id="dbody"></div>`;({unit:renderUnit,trend:renderTrend,points:renderPoints,diag:renderDiag,tests:renderTests,wire:renderWiring,sens:renderSensors})[sub]()}
const refocus=id=>{const e=$('#'+id);e.focus();e.setSelectionRange(e.value.length,e.value.length)};
function renderUnit(){const u=unit(W),c=cfg(W),n=pts(W).length,tt=tests(W).length;
 $('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Type your nameplate info, then pick the configuration. The points, service tests, LEDs and menus change to match — just like the real controller.</div>
 <div class="card"><h3>Unit information</h3><label class="fld">Model number<input id="u-m" value="${esc(u.model)}" placeholder="e.g. YHC120…"></label><label class="fld">Serial number<input id="u-s" value="${esc(u.serial)}" placeholder="from the nameplate"></label><label class="fld">Firmware version<input id="u-f" value="${esc(u.fw)}" placeholder="e.g. 7.0.1234"></label>
 <div class="bar"><button onclick="autoFill()">Auto-fill from model</button></div><div class="mu" id="u-note">Shown on the LCD under Utilities ▸ About, the app Home screen and the top bar.</div></div>
 <div class="card"><h3>Configuration (${TY[W].n})</h3>${cfgFields(W).map(f=>`<label class="fld">${f[1]}<select onchange="cfg(W)['${f[0]}']=this.value;cfgChanged();renderUnit()">${f[2].map(o=>`<option ${c[f[0]]==o?'selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`).join('')}
 <div class="hint">Right now: <b>${n}</b> points, <b>${tt}</b> service tests and <b>${diagList(W).length}</b> alarms are active for this setup.</div></div>`;
 ['m','s','f'].forEach(k=>$('#u-'+k).oninput=e=>{unit(W)[{m:'model',s:'serial',f:'fw'}[k]]=e.target.value;LSs('sb7_u',UI_);$('#tu').textContent=unitLine()})}
function autoFill(){const m=unit(W).model,x=/(\d{3})/.exec(m||'');const ok=[24,30,36,48,60,72,90,102,120,150,180,210,240,300,360,480,600].map(n=>String(n).padStart(3,'0'));if(x&&ok.includes(x[1])){const tons=+x[1]/12;$('#u-note').innerHTML='Model number contains <b>'+x[1]+'</b> → about <b>'+tons+' tons</b>. Best guess only — confirm on the nameplate and set the configuration below.'}else $('#u-note').textContent='No tonnage code found. Set the configuration below by hand.'}
function renderTrend(){const T=TRD[W];$('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Upload a trend export (.CSV) from a real controller. The simulator maps each column to a point, then “Simulate trends” replays the rows so the board, LEDs, menus and app react.</div>
 <div class="card"><h3>Trend data upload</h3><div class="dz" id="dz">Drag &amp; drop your .CSV here<br><span class="mu">or</span><br><button class="p" onclick="$('#tf').click()">Choose file</button><input id="tf" type="file" accept=".csv,.txt,text/csv,application/vnd.ms-excel" hidden></div>
 <div class="mu" style="margin-top:6px">${T?'Loaded: <b>'+esc(T.name)+'</b> – '+T.cols.length+' columns, '+T.times.length+' rows':'No trend loaded for '+TY[W].n+' yet.'}</div></div>
 ${T?`<div class="card" id="simbar"><h3>Simulate trends</h3><div class="bar"><button id="simgo" class="p" onclick="TS.play?stopSim():startSim()">▶ Simulate trends</button><select onchange="TS.spd=+this.value;TS.play&&startSim()"><option value="1">1× speed</option><option value="2">2×</option><option value="5">5×</option><option value="10">10×</option></select><button onclick="TS.idx=0;applyRow();simUI()">⏮</button><button onclick="TS.idx=Math.min(TRD[W].times.length-1,TS.idx+1);applyRow();simUI()">Step ▶</button></div><input type="range" min="0" max="${T.times.length-1}" value="${TS.idx}" style="width:100%" oninput="TS.idx=+this.value;applyRow();simUI()"><div class="mu" id="simt"></div><div class="bar"><button onclick="clearTrendVals()">Clear trend values</button><button onclick="dropTrend()">🗑 Remove trend</button></div></div>
 <div class="card"><h3>Columns → points</h3><div class="mu">Each column is matched to a point by name. Change it if needed.</div>${T.cols.map((c,i)=>`<div class="pr"><div class="nm"><b>${esc(c.h)}</b><div class="mu">${c.v.filter(x=>x!==null).slice(0,3).join(', ')}…</div></div><select style="max-width:48%" onchange="remap(${i},this.value)"><option value="">(new custom point)</option>${allPts(W).filter(p=>p.k!='T').map(p=>`<option ${c.map==p.n?'selected':''}>${esc(p.n)}</option>`).join('')}${c.map==c.h&&!allPts(W).some(p=>p.n==c.h&&p.k!='T')?`<option selected>${esc(c.h)}</option>`:''}</select></div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}`;
 const dz=$('#dz');['dragenter','dragover'].forEach(e=>dz.addEventListener(e,ev=>{ev.preventDefault();dz.classList.add('over')}));['dragleave','drop'].forEach(e=>dz.addEventListener(e,ev=>{ev.preventDefault();dz.classList.remove('over')}));dz.addEventListener('drop',ev=>loadTrendFile(ev.dataTransfer.files[0]));$('#tf').onchange=e=>loadTrendFile(e.target.files[0]);simUI()}
function remap(i,v){const c=TRD[W].cols[i];c.map=v;linkTrend(W);dbPut('trend',TRD[W]);applyRow();renderTrend()}
function renderPoints(){const g=($('#pg')||{}).value||'',q=($('#pq')||{}).value||'',L=pts(W).filter(p=>(!g||p.g==g)&&(!q||p.n.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())));
 $('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">These are the starting points. Tap any value to change it — including <span class="tag wo">WRITE-ONLY</span> BAS commands. Starting values are typical defaults; your trend overrides them while it plays.</div>
 <input id="pq" class="sb" placeholder="🔎 Search points…" value="${esc(q)}" oninput="renderPoints();const e=$('#pq');e.focus();e.setSelectionRange(e.value.length,e.value.length)"><select id="pg" class="sb" onchange="renderPoints()"><option value="">All groups</option>${[...GRP,'Trend'].map(x=>`<option ${g==x?'selected':''}>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select>
 <div class="card">${L.map(p=>`<div class="pr" onclick="editPoint('${esc(p.n).replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')"><div class="nm">${esc(p.n)}<div><span class="tag ${KC[p.k]}">${KL[p.k]}</span><span class="tag">${p.g}</span>${edited(W,p.n)?'<span class="tag sp">EDITED</span>':''}</div></div><div class="v">${esc(fmt(p,val(W,p.n)))}</div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="mu">No points match.</div>'}</div><div class="bar"><button onclick="if(confirm('Reset every edited value?')){V[W]={};LSs('sb7_v',V);draw();renderPoints()}">Reset all edits</button></div>`}
function renderDiag(){const q=($('#dq')||{}).value||'',on_=DGON[W]||(DGON[W]={}),L=diagInfo(W).filter(d=>diagList(W).includes(d.n)&&(!q||d.n.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))),gs=[...new Set(L.map(d=>d.g))];
 $('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Every diagnostic listed in the ${TY[W].doc} guide. Flip a switch to trip it and watch LED 10, the LCD Alarms list and the app. <span class="tag wo">ALARM RELAY</span> = drives the alarm output. Tap a page chip for the guide.</div>
 <input id="dq" class="sb" placeholder="🔎 Search alarms…" value="${esc(q)}" oninput="renderDiag();refocus('dq')"><div class="card"><b>${alarms().length} active</b> · alarm output relay: <b>${alarms().length?(alarmRelay()?'ON':'OFF'):'OFF'}</b> <button style="float:right" onclick="DGON[W]={};draw();renderDiag()">Clear all</button></div>
 ${gs.map(g=>`<div class="mu" style="margin:8px 2px">${esc(g)}</div><div class="card">${L.filter(d=>d.g==g).map(d=>`<div class="pr"><div class="nm">${esc(d.n)}<div>${d.a===true?'<span class="tag wo">ALARM RELAY</span>':''}<a class="chip" href="${TY[W].g}#page=${d.pg}">p.${d.pg} ↗</a></div></div><span class="sw ${on_[d.n]?'on':''}" onclick="tripDiag(${d.i})"></span></div>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="card mu">No match.</div>'}`}
function tripDiag(i){const n=GD[W].diag[i].n,o=DGON[W]||(DGON[W]={});o[n]=!o[n];draw();renderDiag()}
function runTest(i){const n=tests(W)[i];S.test=S.test==n?null:n;draw();renderTests()}
function renderTests(){const v=svcVar(W),L=tests(W);$('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Real service test states from the ${TY[W].doc} guide. Tap Run to energize a state and watch the LEDs, LCD and app. “In Control” means the controller keeps control of that output. The list follows your configuration.</div>
 <div class="card"><b>${esc(v.t)}</b><div class="mu">Test ends on timeout (${W=='odyssey'?'1–120 min, default 60':'default 60 min'}), when set to Inactive, or after a power cycle.</div><a class="chip" href="${TY[W].g}#page=${v.pg}">Guide p.${v.pg} ↗</a></div>
 ${L.map((n,i)=>{const r=testRow(W,n);return`<div class="card"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><b style="flex:1">${esc(n)}</b><button class="${S.test==n?'':'p'}" onclick="runTest(${i})">${S.test==n?'■ Stop':'▶ Run'}</button></div>${r.cols.map((c,k)=>`<div class="pr"><div class="nm">${esc(c)}</div><div class="v">${esc(r.vals[k]||'')}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`}).join('')}`}
function renderWiring(){const q=($('#wq')||{}).value||'',L=GD[W].wire.filter(r=>!q||(r.c+' '+r.f+' '+r.s).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())),cs=[...new Set(L.map(r=>r.c))];
 $('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Field connections from Table 1 of the ${TY[W].doc} guide (Symbio 700 board terminals).</div><input id="wq" class="sb" placeholder="🔎 Search connector or signal…" value="${esc(q)}" oninput="renderWiring();refocus('wq')">
 ${cs.map(c=>{const rs=L.filter(r=>r.c==c);return`<div class="card"><b>${esc(c)}</b> – ${esc(rs[0].f)} <a class="chip" href="${TY[W].g}#page=${rs[0].pg}">p.${rs[0].pg} ↗</a>${rs.map(r=>`<div class="pr"><div class="nm">Pin ${esc(r.pin)}</div><div class="v">${esc(r.s)}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card mu">No match.</div>'}`}
const SNS={therm:['10K thermistor (temperature sensors)',['Temp (°F)','Temp (°C)','Resistance (ohms)','Terminal voltage (V)']],zsp:['Zone sensor – setpoint input',['Temp (°F)','Resistance (ohms)','Terminal voltage (V)']],rh:['Relative humidity sensor',['Relative humidity (%)','Current (mA)']],co2:['CO2 sensor',['CO2 (ppm)','Terminal voltage (V)']]};
let SN={k:'therm',c:0,x:''};
function sensRows(k){return GD[W].sens[k]||(k=='therm'?GD.precedent.sens.therm:null)}
function interp(rows,ci,x){const a=[...rows].sort((p,q)=>p[ci]-q[ci]);if(x<a[0][ci]||x>a[a.length-1][ci])return null;for(let i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){if(x>=a[i][ci]&&x<=a[i+1][ci]){const f=a[i+1][ci]==a[i][ci]?0:(x-a[i][ci])/(a[i+1][ci]-a[i][ci]);return a[i].map((v,k)=>v+(a[i+1][k]-v)*f)}}return null}
function renderSensors(){const rows=sensRows(SN.k),names=SNS[SN.k][1].slice(0,rows?rows[0].length:0);
 $('#dbody').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">Look up what a sensor should read. Tables come from the ${TY[W].doc} guide. Pick a sensor, choose what you know, type the number, and read the rest.</div>
 <div class="card"><label class="fld">Sensor<select onchange="SN={k:this.value,c:0,x:''};renderSensors()">${Object.keys(SNS).map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${SN.k==k?'selected':''}>${SNS[k][0]}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
 ${rows?`${SN.k=='therm'&&!GD[W].sens.therm?`<div class="mu">This guide has no thermistor table; the Precedent/Foundation 10K table is shown.</div>`:''}<label class="fld">I know the…<select onchange="SN.c=+this.value;renderSensors()">${names.map((n,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${SN.c==i?'selected':''}>${n}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label class="fld">Value<input id="snx" type="number" step="any" value="${esc(SN.x)}" oninput="SN.x=this.value;sensOut()"></label><div id="snout" class="hint"></div>`:`<div class="card mu">${TY[W].n} guide has no table for this sensor.</div>`}</div>
 ${rows?`<div class="card" style="max-height:300px;overflow:auto"><table><tr>${names.map(n=>`<th>${n}</th>`).join('')}</tr>${rows.map(r=>`<tr>${r.map(v=>`<td>${v}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</table></div>`:''}`;sensOut()}
function sensOut(){const e=$('#snout');if(!e)return;const rows=sensRows(SN.k),x=parseFloat(SN.x);if(isNaN(x)){e.textContent='Type a number above.';return}const r=interp(rows,SN.c,x);if(!r){e.textContent='Outside the table range.';return}const n=SNS[SN.k][1];e.innerHTML=r.map((v,i)=>i==SN.c?'':n[i]+': <b>'+(+v.toFixed(3))+'</b>').filter(Boolean).join('<br>')}
/* ===== Learn ===== */
const GTOC=t=>(TOC[t]||[]).map(x=>`<div class="lk" style="padding-left:${x[2]*10}px"><span>${esc(x[0])}</span><a class="chip" href="${TY[t].g}#page=${x[1]}">p.${x[1]} ↗</a></div>`).join('');
function renderLearn(){const t=W,T=TY[t],isG=t=='general';
 const easy=isG?`<li>Open <b>BAS-SVU054C-EN</b> below – the User Guide that works for every type.</li><li>Pick a type from the home screen to practise on the board.</li><li>Store anything useful in <b>Files</b>.</li>`:`<li><b>Data ▸ Unit</b>: type model, serial, firmware and choose the configuration.</li><li><b>Data ▸ Trend data</b>: upload a .CSV and tap <b>Simulate trends</b>.</li><li><b>Board</b>: tap the keypad and watch the LCD, LEDs and menus.</li><li><b>App</b>: open the phone app to see Home, Status, Alarms and Tools.</li><li><b>Quiz</b>: test yourself.</li>`;
 $('#s-learn').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><h3>👋 Easy start – ${T.n}</h3><div class="mu">${T.b}</div><ol style="padding-left:20px;margin:8px 0">${easy}</ol></div>
 <div class="card"><h3>📘 Symbio 700 User Guide (BAS-SVU054C-EN)</h3><div class="mu">Works for every type. Opens the page with the wording highlighted. Swipe from the left edge to come back.</div><p><a href="manual.html"><button class="p">Open the User Guide ↗</button></a> <a href="BAS-SVU054C-EN.pdf"><button>Original PDF ↗</button></a></p></div>
 ${isG?`<div class="card"><h3>📚 Application guides by type</h3>${SIM.map(k=>`<div class="lk"><span><b>${TY[k].n}</b><br><span class="mu">${TY[k].doc}</span></span><a class="chip" href="${TY[k].g}">Open ↗</a></div>`).join('')}</div>`:`<details class="card" open><summary>📗 ${T.n} application guide (${T.doc})</summary><div class="mu">Tap a page chip to open that page. Swipe from the left edge to come back.</div><p><a href="${T.g}"><button class="p">Open the ${T.n} guide ↗</button></a></p><div style="max-height:340px;overflow:auto">${GTOC(t)}</div></details>`}
 <div class="mu" style="margin:6px 2px">User Guide topics</div>${LN.map((x,i)=>`<details><summary>${x[0]}</summary>${x[1]}<div class="lks">${(LK[i]||[]).map(k=>{const m=k[0].match(/^(.*) p\.(\d+)$/);return `<div class="lk"><span>${m[1]}</span><a class="chip" href="manual.html?h=${k[1]}">Guide p.${m[2]} ↗</a></div>`}).join('')}</div></details>`).join('')}
 <div class="mu" style="margin:10px">⚠ Only qualified personnel should service equipment. Follow PPE, arc-flash, LOTO and local code.</div>`}
/* ===== Menu tab ===== */
function renderMenu(){const m=MENU();$('#s-menu').innerHTML=`<div class="hint">These are the real menu paths for the <b>${TY[W].n}</b> setup. Tap one to jump the board LCD there. Change the configuration in Data ▸ Unit and this list changes too.</div><div class="card"><div class="tree">${Object.keys(m).map((k,i)=>`<div class="m">${k}</div>`+Object.keys(m[k]).map((s,j)=>`<div style="padding-left:14px">└ <a href="#" onclick="go(${i},${j});return false">${s}</a> <span class="mu">${m[k][s]().length} item${m[k][s]().length==1?'':'s'}</span></div>`).join('')).join('')}</div></div>`}
function go(i,j){M={mode:'nav',lvl:2,mi:i,si:j,pi:0,ed:0,ev:null};showTab('board');draw();scrollTo(0,0)}
/* ===== search ===== */
function searchAll(q,only){q=q.toLowerCase().trim();if(q.length<2)return[];const R=[];(only&&only!='general'?[only]:SIM).forEach(t=>{if(t=='general')return;pts(t).forEach(p=>{if(p.n.toLowerCase().includes(q))R.push({k:'Point',t,l:p.n,s:TY[t].n+' · '+p.g+' · '+KL[p.k],go:()=>{openWork(t,'data');renderData('points');$('#pq').value=p.n;renderPoints()}})});diagList(t).forEach(n=>{if(n.toLowerCase().includes(q))R.push({k:'Alarm',t,l:n,s:TY[t].n,go:()=>{openWork(t,'data');renderData('diag')}})});tests(t).forEach(n=>{if(n.toLowerCase().includes(q))R.push({k:'Test',t,l:'Service test: '+n,s:TY[t].n,go:()=>openWork(t,'menu')})});GD[t].wire.forEach(r=>{if((r.c+' '+r.f+' '+r.s).toLowerCase().includes(q))R.push({k:'Wiring',t,l:r.c+' pin '+r.pin+' – '+r.s,s:TY[t].n+' · '+r.f,go:()=>{openWork(t,'data');renderData('wire')}})});(TOC[t]||[]).forEach(x=>{if(x[0].toLowerCase().includes(q))R.push({k:'Guide',t,l:x[0],s:TY[t].doc+' p.'+x[1],go:()=>location.href=TY[t].g+'#page='+x[1]})})});
 LN.forEach((x,i)=>{if((x[0]+x[1]).toLowerCase().includes(q))R.push({k:'Learn',t:only||'general',l:x[0],s:'User Guide topic',go:()=>{openWork(only||'general','learn')}})});
 RP.forEach(o=>{if((o.name+' '+(o.text||'')+' '+(o.url||'')).toLowerCase().includes(q)&&(!only||only=='general'||o.cats.includes(only)))R.push({k:'File',t:'general',l:o.name,s:o.kind,go:()=>openItem(o.id)})});return R.slice(0,40)}
function showRes(box,q,only){const R=searchAll(q,only);window['_r'+box]=R;$('#'+box).innerHTML=R.length?`<div class="res">${R.map((r,i)=>`<div onclick="_r${box}[${i}].go();$('#${box}').innerHTML=''"><span class="tag">${r.k}</span>${esc(r.l)}<br><small>${esc(r.s)}</small></div>`).join('')}</div>`:q.length>1?'<div class="res"><div class="mu">Nothing found.</div></div>':''}
/* ===== workspace navigation ===== */
function cards(){$('#cards').innerHTML=ORDER.map(k=>{const T=TY[k];return`<button class="tcard" style="--c:${T.c}" onclick="openWork('${k}')"><b>${T.n}</b><span>${T.s}</span><span>${T.b}</span></button>`}).join('')}
function goHome(){stopSim();W=null;$('#work').classList.remove('on');$('#home').classList.add('on');scrollTo(0,0)}
async function openWork(t,tab){if(W&&W!=t)stopSim();W=t;$('#home').classList.remove('on');$('#work').classList.add('on');$('#tn').textContent=TY[t].n;$('#top').style.borderBottomColor=TY[t].c;$('#ws').value='';$('#wres').innerHTML='';
 if(t!='general'){cfg(t);if(!TRD[t]){const a=(await dbAll('trend')).find(x=>x.type==t);if(a){TRD[t]=a;linkTrend(t)}}M={mode:'nav',lvl:0,mi:0,si:0,pi:0,ed:0,ev:null};S.test=null}
 const nv=t=='general'?[['learn','📖','Learn'],['files','📁','Files'],['quiz','✅','Quiz']]:[['board','📟','Board'],['led','💡','LEDs'],['app','📱','App'],['menu','🧭','Menu'],['data','🎛','Data'],['learn','📖','Learn'],['quiz','✅','Quiz'],['files','📁','Files']];
 $('#nav').innerHTML=nv.map(n=>n[0]=='app'?`<button onclick="openApp()"><b>${n[1]}</b>${n[2]}</button>`:`<button data-t="${n[0]}" onclick="showTab('${n[0]}')"><b>${n[1]}</b>${n[2]}</button>`).join('');
 showTab(tab||(t=='general'?'learn':'board'));scrollTo(0,0)}
function showTab(t){$$('#work section').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('on',s.id=='s-'+t));$$('#nav button[data-t]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.t==t));
 ({menu:renderMenu,data:()=>renderData(),learn:renderLearn,files:renderFiles,quiz:quiz,board:draw,led:draw})[t]&&({menu:renderMenu,data:()=>renderData(),learn:renderLearn,files:renderFiles,quiz:quiz,board:draw,led:draw})[t]();scrollTo(0,0)}
/* ===== point editor (works for every point, incl. write-only) ===== */
let EP=null;
function editPoint(n){const p=allPts(W).find(x=>x.n==n);if(!p)return;EP=n;const v=val(W,n),note={S:'Status point. On a real unit this is measured. Changing it here simulates a reading.',SP:'Setpoint. You can change it on the controller and in the app.',CMD:'WRITE-ONLY BAS command. The controller accepts it but never reports it back, so the simulator just remembers the last value you wrote.',CFG:'Configuration setting.',T:'Point created from a column of your trend file.'}[p.k];
 const inp=p.o?`<select id="ev">${p.o.map(o=>`<option ${String(v)==o?'selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select>`:`<input id="ev" type="${typeof p.d=='number'?'number':'text'}" step="any" value="${esc(v)}">`;
 $('#mod').innerHTML=`<div><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px">${esc(p.n)}</h3><span class="tag ${KC[p.k]}">${KL[p.k]}</span><span class="tag">${p.g}</span><p class="mu">${note}</p><label class="fld">Value ${p.u&&p.u!='stage'?'('+p.u+')':''}${inp}</label><div class="bar"><button class="p" onclick="savePoint()">Save</button><button onclick="resetPoint()">Reset to default</button><button onclick="$('#mod').classList.remove('on')">Cancel</button></div></div>`;$('#mod').classList.add('on')}
function savePoint(){const p=allPts(W).find(x=>x.n==EP),e=$('#ev');let v=e.value;if(!p.o&&typeof p.d=='number'){v=parseFloat(v);if(isNaN(v)){toast('Enter a number');return}}setVal(W,EP,v);$('#mod').classList.remove('on');draw();$('#s-data').classList.contains('on')&&renderData()}
function resetPoint(){if(V[W])delete V[W][EP];if(VT[W])delete VT[W][EP];LSs('sb7_v',V);$('#mod').classList.remove('on');draw();$('#s-data').classList.contains('on')&&renderData()}
/* ===== phone app (Trane Symbio Service & Installation) ===== */
const A={scr:'login',tab:'home',paired:0,pop:0,cfg:0,tmp:null,grp:null,sort:'Severity',q:''};
function openApp(){if(!W||W=='general')return;$('#ph').classList.add('on');S.app=1;app();steps()}
const sev=()=>({Critical:0,'Service Required':alarms().length,Advisory:0,Information:0});
const pt_=n=>allPts(W).find(x=>x.n==n);
const li=(l,v,n)=>`<div class="li" ${n?`onclick="editPoint('${esc(n).replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')"`:''}><small style="color:#777">${esc(l)}</small><span ${n?'class="g2"':''} style="font-size:17px">${esc(v)}</span></div>`;
function staHtml(){const q=A.q.toLowerCase();return pts(W).filter(p=>p.k=='S'||p.k=='SP').filter(p=>!q||p.n.toLowerCase().includes(q)).map(p=>li(p.n+' - Active',fmt(p,val(W,p.n)),p.n)).join('')||'<div class="mu">No match</div>'}
function staList(){$('#stl').innerHTML=staHtml()}
function app(){if(!W||W=='general')return;if(S.bt!=2)A.paired=0;else if(S.sel&&!A.pop&&!A.paired&&S.code==null)A.paired=1;
 const b=$('#pb'),t=$('#pt');let h='';t.innerHTML='';
 if(!A.paired){
  if(A.scr=='login')h=`<div style="height:260px;background:linear-gradient(#555,#222);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:800 30px system-ui;color:#6c3">TRANE</div><p><button class="p" style="width:100%" onclick="S.vad=1;A.scr='list';draw()">View Available Devices</button></p><button style="width:100%" onclick="toast('Trane personnel only – Trane Connect login')">Log in to Trane Connect Remote Access</button>`;
  else{const ok=S.ph&&S.bt==1&&!S.other,u=unit(W);h=`<b>Unit List</b> <button style="float:right" onclick="toast(S.ph?'Refreshed':'Phone Bluetooth is off');draw()">↻</button><div style="clear:both"></div>${!S.ph?'<p>Bluetooth is off on this phone (lesson step 1).</p>':ok?`<div class="li" onclick="pair()"><b>${esc(u.serial?TY[W].n+'-'+u.serial:'Odyssey-ESEC4006SEC1')}</b><small>Tap to pair</small></div><div class="mu">Note: a replacement (non-original) Symbio 700 lists the controller serial number, not the equipment serial number.</div>`:'<p>No controllers found. Press the controller Bluetooth button until the blue LED blinks (WAITING…), then ↻. A solid blue LED means someone else is connected.</p>'}<p><button onclick="A.scr='login';draw()">‹ Back</button></p>`}
  if(A.pop&&S.code)h+=`<div class="modal"><div><b>Bluetooth Pairing Request</b><p>This controller would like to pair. Confirm the code <b style="font-size:20px">${S.code}</b> is shown on the controller.</p><button onclick="S.code=null;S.sel=0;A.pop=0;draw()">Cancel</button> <button class="p" onclick="A.pop=0;toast('Now press ✔ on the board');draw()">Pair</button></div></div>`;
  if(S.sel&&S.code&&!A.pop)h+=`<div style="background:#e8f5e4;border:1px solid #4cae3c;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-top:10px"><b>Pairing in progress</b><br>Confirm code <b>${S.code}</b> matches the controller LCD, then close this app and press ✔ on the board.<p><button class="p" onclick="$('#ph').classList.remove('on')">Close app &amp; go to board</button></p></div>`;
 }else{
  const tabs=[['home','🏠','Home'],['set','⚙️','Settings'],['sta','📈','Status'],['alm','⏰','Alarms'],['tool','🛠','Tools']],al=alarms(),u=unit(W);
  t.innerHTML=tabs.map(x=>`<button class="${A.tab==x[0]?'on':''}" onclick="A.tab='${x[0]}';A.grp=null;A.cfg=0;app()"><div style="font-size:18px">${x[1]}</div>${x[2]}</button>`).join('');
  if(A.tab=='home')h=(al.length?`<div style="background:#ffb35c;padding:12px;border-radius:8px"><b>${esc(al[0])}</b><br>Service Required <span style="float:right">1/${al.length}</span></div>`:'')+`<div style="background:#000;color:#fff;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;margin:8px 0">${TY[W].n} <span style="float:right;color:#6c3">SHOW MORE</span><br><small>Model ${esc(u.model||'—')} · S/N ${esc(u.serial||'—')} · FW ${esc(u.fw||'—')}</small></div>`+[['SUPPLY FAN SPEED STATUS','Supply Fan Speed Status'],['COOLING CAPACITY STATUS','Cooling Capacity Status'],['HEAT COOL MODE STATUS','Heat Cool Mode Status'],['THERMOSTAT G INPUT','Thermostat G Input'],['THERMOSTAT W1/O INPUT','Thermostat W1/O Input'],['SPACE TEMPERATURE','Space Temperature']].map(([l,n])=>li(l,fmt(pt_(n),val(W,n)))).join('');
  if(A.tab=='set'&&!A.cfg)h=`<b>Settings</b><div class="li" onclick="A.cfg=1;app()">View Configuration</div><div class="li" onclick="A.cfg=4;app()">Manage Settings</div>`+pts(W).filter(p=>p.k!='S').slice(0,6).map(p=>li(p.n,fmt(p,val(W,p.n)),p.n)).join('');
  if(A.tab=='set'&&A.cfg==1)h=`<button onclick="A.cfg=0;app()">‹</button> <b>Configuration</b> <button style="float:right" onclick="A.cfg=2;app()">EDIT</button>${li('Model number',u.model||'—')}${li('Serial number',u.serial||'—')}${li('Firmware version',u.fw||'—')}${cfgFields(W).map(f=>li(f[1],cfg(W)[f[0]])).join('')}`;
  if(A.tab=='set'&&A.cfg==2)h=`<div class="modal"><div><b>Stopping the Equipment</b><p>To edit the hardware configuration the equipment must be stopped. Are you sure you want to continue?</p><button onclick="A.cfg=1;app()">CANCEL</button> <button class="p" onclick="A.tmp={...cfg(W)};A.cfg=3;app()">PROCEED</button></div></div>`;
  if(A.tab=='set'&&A.cfg==3)h=`<button onclick="A.cfg=1;app()">✕</button> <b>Edit</b> <button class="p" style="float:right" onclick="Object.assign(cfg(W),A.tmp);cfgChanged();A.cfg=1;toast('Configuration saved – '+pts(W).length+' points active');app()">✓</button><div class="mu">Changing options shows or hides points, tests and alarms.</div>${cfgFields(W).map(f=>`<div class="li"><small>${f[1]}</small><select style="width:100%;padding:6px" onchange="A.tmp['${f[0]}']=this.value">${f[2].map(o=>`<option ${A.tmp[f[0]]==o?'selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`).join('')}`;
  if(A.tab=='set'&&A.cfg==4)h=`<button onclick="A.cfg=0;app()">‹</button> <b>Manage Settings</b>${pts(W).filter(p=>p.k!='S').map(p=>li(p.n+(p.k=='CMD'?'  (write-only)':''),fmt(p,val(W,p.n)),p.n)).join('')}`;
  if(A.tab=='sta')h=`<b>Status</b><div class="mu">Tap green text to override a value.</div><input style="width:100%;padding:8px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:8px;margin:6px 0" placeholder="Search" value="${esc(A.q)}" oninput="A.q=this.value;staList()"><div id="stl">${staHtml()}</div>`;
  if(A.tab=='alm'&&!A.grp){const v=sev();h=`<div style="background:#f25c64;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700">${al.length} Active alarms</div><p style="text-align:center"><b>Alarm History</b></p><div class="bar">${['Severity','Date','Source'].map(s=>`<button class="${A.sort==s?'p':''}" onclick="A.sort='${s}';app()">${s}</button>`).join('')}</div>${Object.entries(v).map(([k,n])=>`<div class="sev" onclick="A.grp='${k}';app()"><span>${k}</span><b>${n}</b></div>`).join('')}<div class="mu">Trip alarms in Data ▸ Alarms, or let your trend do it.</div>`}
  if(A.tab=='alm'&&A.grp)h=`<button onclick="A.grp=null;app()">‹</button> <b>${A.grp}</b>${A.grp=='Service Required'&&al.length?al.map(n=>`<div class="li">${esc(n)}<small>Sorted by ${A.sort}</small></div>`).join(''):'<div class="li">No alarms in this group</div>'}`;
  if(A.tab=='tool'&&!A.grp)h='<b>Tools</b>'+['Service Test Mode','Export Data Logs','Service','Protocol Configuration','LonTalk™','IP Configuration','Regional Specifications','Intelligent Services','TGP2 Programs','Backup','Restore'].map(x=>`<div class="li" onclick="${x=='Service Test Mode'?"A.grp='t';app()":`toast('${x} – see Learn tab')`}">${x}</div>`).join('');
  if(A.tab=='tool'&&A.grp=='t')h=`<button onclick="A.grp=null;app()">‹</button> <b>Service Test Mode</b><div style="padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin:8px 0;color:#fff;background:${S.test?'#5aaf35':'#888'}">Active Test<br><b>${S.test?S.test.toUpperCase():'INACTIVE'}</b></div>${S.test&&testRow(W,S.test)?`<div class="mu" style="color:#222">${testRow(W,S.test).cols.map((c,i)=>esc(c)+': <b>'+esc(testRow(W,S.test).vals[i]||'')+'</b>').join('<br>')}</div>`:''}${tests(W).map(m=>`<div class="li"><span>${m}</span><button style="float:right" onclick="S.test=${S.test==m?'null':`'${m}'`};draw()">${S.test==m?'■':'▶'}</button></div>`).join('')}<div class="mu">Times out after the Service Test Timeout (60 min default) or when power is cycled. These tests match your configuration.</div>`;
 }
 b.innerHTML=h}
function pair(){S.sel=1;S.code=String(100000+Math.floor(Math.random()*900000));A.pop=1;M.mode='bt';draw()}
/* ===== start ===== */
$('#gs').oninput=e=>showRes('gres',e.target.value,null);$('#ws').oninput=e=>showRes('wres',e.target.value,W);
cards();repoInit();
let SEL=null;const nm=l=>isNaN(l[0])?l[1]:(l[1].startsWith('LED')?l[1]:'LED '+l[0]+' – '+l[1]),ord=l=>isNaN(l[0])?(l[0]=='MB'?10.5:10.6):+l[0];
$('#blist').innerHTML=[...LD].sort((a,b)=>ord(a)-ord(b)).map(l=>`<div class="row" data-n="${l[0]}" onclick="sel('${l[0]}')" style="padding:9px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln)"><i class="led ${l[4]}" data-n="${l[0]}" data-c="${l[4]}"></i><b>${nm(l)}</b> <span class="mu">▸ locate</span></div>`).join('');
function sel(n){const l=LD.find(x=>x[0]==n);if(!l)return;SEL=l;$('#sel').style.display='block';$('#sel').innerHTML=`<b>${nm(l)}</b><div style="margin-top:4px">${l[5]}</div><div class="bar"><button onclick="clr()">Clear arrow</button></div>`;arrow();$$('#blist .row').forEach(r=>r.style.background=r.dataset.n==n?'#243444':'');$('#bd').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}
function clr(){SEL=null;arrow();$('#sel').style.display='none';$$('#blist .row').forEach(r=>r.style.background='')}
function arrow(){const sv=$('#ar'),bd=$('#bd');if(!SEL){sv.innerHTML='';return}const w=bd.clientWidth,h=bd.clientHeight,x=SEL[2]/100*w,y=SEL[3]/100*h,sx=x<w*.5?x+70:x-70,sy=y>h*.7?y-80:y+80,dx=x-sx,dy=y-sy,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy),ux=dx/L,uy=dy/L,ex=x-ux*9,ey=y-uy*9,px=-uy,py=ux;sv.innerHTML=`<line x1="${sx}" y1="${sy}" x2="${ex-ux*14}" y2="${ey-uy*14}" stroke="#ff3b30" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon fill="#ff3b30" points="${ex},${ey} ${ex-ux*20+px*9},${ey-uy*20+py*9} ${ex-ux*20-px*9},${ey-uy*20-py*9}"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ff3b30" stroke-width="2"/>`}
addEventListener('resize',arrow);const IC={home:'<path d="M3 12L12 3l9 9M5 10v10h5v-6h4v6h5V10"/>',bt:'<path d="M7 7l10 10-5 5V2l5 5L7 17"/>',up:'<path d="M5 15l7-7 7 7"/>',down:'<path d="M5 9l7 7 7-7"/>',left:'<path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/>',right:'<path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>',ok:'<path d="M4 12l6 7L20 5"/>',cancel:'<path d="M5 12a7 7 0 1 0 2.5-5.4M4 4v5h5"/>'},PA={home:'1/1',bt:'2/1',up:'1/3',left:'2/2',right:'2/4',down:'2/3',ok:'1/5',cancel:'2/5'};
$('#pad').innerHTML='<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px;justify-items:center;max-width:340px;margin:auto">'+Object.keys(IC).map(k=>`<button class="pb" style="grid-area:${PA[k].replace('/',' / ')}" onclick="key('${k}')" aria-label="${k}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="28" height="28" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${IC[k]}</svg></button>`).join('')+'</div>';

</script></body></html>
